import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, ipaddress
rng = random.Random(21)
def ip(x): return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(x))
# 60000 rows all aliasing 63 distinct /128 routes (+ ::/0) -> R=64
base = [["::/0", 1]] + [[ip(i) + "/128", i + 1] for i in range(1, 63)]
rows = []
while len(rows) < 59990:
    rows.extend([list(r) for r in base])
rows = rows[:59990]
bursts = []
total = 0
for b in range(128):
    addrs = [ip(rng.randrange(0, 64)) for _ in range(64)]
    bursts.append({"version": 0, "repeat": 999999, "addresses": addrs})
    total += 64
req = {"cases": [{"initial": rows, "transactions": [], "bursts": bursts,
                  "cache_pages": 12, "costs": {"hit": 16, "miss": 256, "decode": [16, 16, 16]}}]}
data = json.dumps(req).encode()
print('input bytes', len(data), 'addrs', total)
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=data,
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('rc', p.returncode, '%.1fs' % (time.time() - t), 'out', len(p.stdout), p.stderr[:300])
if p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout.startswith(b'{"cases"'):
    r = json.loads(p.stdout)
    print('objective', r['cases'][0]['objective'])
EOF
